source_direct_findings: VoxCPM2 is described by the primary repository/model card as a 2B tokenizer-free diffusion-autoregressive TTS system with 30-language support including German and 48 kHz output.
The primary implementation exposes local streaming generation through generate_streaming().
The primary sources report approximately 8 GB VRAM and RTF about 0.30 on RTX 4090 for the standard path, with about 0.13 reported for Nano-vLLM acceleration.
Weights and source are presented as Apache-2.0/commercial-ready by the primary project surfaces.

OpenBMB UltraEval-Audio reports a reproduced German CV3 zero-shot WER/CER of 4.629% versus 4.77% official, SIM 74.461, P808 MOS 3.617; MiniMax German reproduction reports WER 1.054% versus 0.679% official and SIM 79.874 versus 80.3 official. These are upstream/same-organization benchmark results, not Frankenstein measurements.
project_inferences_not_runtime_facts: German benchmark evidence is materially stronger than language-metadata-only support and makes VoxCPM2 a credible quality challenger for Frankenstein's German TTS lane.

The 2B/approximately-8-GB-VRAM envelope is likely substantially more expensive to co-reside than the smallest latency-floor candidates; whole-Frankenstein resource fit must be measured before target execution is prioritized.

Streaming availability plus voice design/control is architecturally attractive for stable male acoustic identity and state-derived prosody, but no barge-in, cancellation, first-audio latency, long-session stability or F2 VoiceOutcome re-entry behavior is established here.
counterhypotheses: Published German quality may not survive the exact Frankenstein male-voice, short-turn, project-vocabulary and interruption workload.
A smaller TTS may produce better end-to-end conversational quality once whole-system latency and co-resident resource contention are included.
Upstream streaming RTF on RTX 4090 does not imply acceptable TTFA, cancellation latency, CPU fallback, or clay-direct-dev behavior.
next_exact_action: Route to Trigger 4 as a deferred bounded target-runtime comparator only after current TTS/resource frontier permits it. If admitted, use the exact pinned model artifact and measure cold/warm TTFA, RTF, p50/p95 chunk cadence, cancellation tail, RSS/VRAM, German intelligibility, stable male-voice consistency, state/prosody controllability and whole-Frankenstein coexistence against the current lighter TTS finalists. Do not award production or runtime credit from upstream results.
